# Town of Edinburgh, Indiana

> > Official municipal website for Edinburgh, Indiana, providing government services, public records, and community resources.

The Town of Edinburgh serves residents with comprehensive municipal services including utilities, parks and recreation, police and fire departments, and planning services. Key facilities include John R Drybread Community Center, Irwin Park, Sports Complex, and Rest Haven Cemetery.

## Key Topics

- Edinburgh, Indiana municipal government
- Town Council and local ordinances
- Public utilities (water, wastewater, electric)
- Edinburgh Police Department (K9 Kira, K9 Skye)
- Parks & Recreation facilities
- John R Drybread Community Center
- Irwin Park and Sports Complex
- Rest Haven Cemetery
- Planning and zoning services
- ADA and Title VI compliance
- Community events (Firecracker Festival, Holiday of Lights)
- Town officials (Ryan Piercefield, Debbie Buck, Miriam Rooks, Sherri Sweet)
- Indiana Code 36-5-2
- Building permits and development
- Emergency services (Fire & Rescue)

## Government & Administration

- [Town Departments Directory](https://www.edinburgh.in.us/department/index.php): Main directory of all municipal departments and town services
- [Town Council](https://www.edinburgh.in.us/council): Town Council members, meeting agendas, and ordinances
- [Boards & Commissions](https://www.edinburgh.in.us/department/board.php): Boards, commissions, and comprehensive municipal service information
- [Document Center](https://www.edinburgh.in.us/egov/apps/document/center.egov): Browse public records and government documents for Edinburgh, Indiana

## Municipal Services

- [Services Index](https://www.edinburgh.in.us/egov/apps/services/index.egov): Complete index of available online and municipal services
- [Utilities & Public Works](https://www.edinburgh.in.us/department/division.php): Rest Haven Cemetery history and comprehensive municipal services info
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.edinburgh.in.us/egov/apps/faq/list.egov): Frequently asked questions about town services and utilities
- [Public Facilities & Locations](https://www.edinburgh.in.us/egov/apps/locations/facilities.egov): Directory of public facilities, parks, and municipal buildings
- [Interactive Maps](https://www.edinburgh.in.us/egov/apps/map/viewer.egov): Interactive map viewer for town geographic information and resources

## Parks, Recreation & Community

- [Parks & Recreation Programs](https://www.edinburgh.in.us/topic): Police Chief message, parks & rec programs, and community events
- [Recreation Rentals & Services](https://www.edinburgh.in.us/topic/subtopic.php): Recreation rentals, utility services, and community survey information

## Business & Economic Development

- [Business Directory](https://www.edinburgh.in.us/egov/apps/business/directory.egov): Searchable directory of local businesses in Edinburgh, Indiana

## Optional

- [Former Police Officers Slideshow](https://www.edinburgh.in.us/egov/apps/slide/show.egov): Historical photo slideshow of former Edinburgh Police Department staff
